approval_evidence.quote: NDA 201699 ... Dificid (fidaxomicin) Tablet for the treatment of Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea in adults (FDA approval letter to Optimer Pharmaceuticals, signed 05/27/2011)

series_start_reason: Merck prints Dificid on its own sales line only from the first-quarter 2022 earnings release and Form 10-Q, which carry the four 2021 quarters as prior-year columns, so the series starts at 2021Q1. Merck's 2015-2021 releases, 10-Qs and 10-Ks print no Dificid sales figure by quarter (the request lists Cubist as the pre-2015 owner; ownership was not researched here). The FY2022 Form 10-K prints annual Dificid sales 2020 of 110, which cannot be split into quarters. Cubist and Optimer, the earlier owners, printed their own Dificid sales before 2015; that history is a different issuer and scope, and it is not spliced onto Merck's series (it was not sourced here).
notes: Worldwide (U.S. plus international) Dificid sales in USD millions from Merck's product sales table, which the 10-Q/10-K tables split into U.S. and international columns. 2021 quarters come from prior-year columns of the 2022 releases. Quarters sum to the printed year within rounding of 1 (2022 262 vs 263); 2021 sums to 175 as printed in the FY2022 10-K; 2023-2025 equal the printed years. Sales fall sharply in 2025Q3-2026Q2 against the prior-year quarters as printed in the releases (2025Q3 43 vs 96).
